🇻🇳 *Hanoi, VIETNAM)*
🏆 *[MICHELIN RESTAURANTS IN VIETNAM!!]*

1️⃣ *Bánh Cuốn Bà Xuân* (Michelin Selected)
Dốc P. Hoè Nhai, Trúc Bạch, Ba Đình, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
8AM - 11:30PM

🌯 *BÁNH CUỐN* (Steamed Rice Rolls With Minced Meat And Wood Ear Mushroom)
💸 *₫35,000 VND / $1.30 USD* (+ Chicken Egg: 20k VND ~ 0.8 USD)

2️⃣ *Tuyết Bún Chả 34* (Bib Gourmand)
34 Hàng Than, Trúc Bạch, Ba Đình, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
8:30AM - 5:30PM

🥘 *BÚN CHẢ 34* (Rice Vermicelli Noodles with Grilled Meat)
💸 *₫55,000 VND / $2.10 USD*

3️⃣ *Miến Lươn Đông Thịnh* (Bib Gourmand)
87 Hàng Điếu, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
6:30AM - 10:00PM

🐍 *MIẾN LƯƠN TRỘN* (Dry Mixed Eel Glass Noodle)
💸 *₫60,000 VND / $2.30 USD* (+ Noodle Soup/Miến Lươn: 50k VND ~ 2 USD)

4️⃣ *Chả Cá Thăng Long* (Bib Gourmand)
6B P. Đường Thành, Cửa Đông, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 000084
10:30AM - 9:00PM

🍽️ *SET CHẢ CÁ*
💸 *₫176,000 VND / $6.70 USD*

5️⃣ *Bún chả Hương Liên* (Michelin Selected)
24 P. Lê Văn Hưu, Phan Chu Trinh, Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
8:00AM - 20:00PM

🇺🇸 *BÚN CHẢ OBAMA*

6️⃣ *Tầm Vị* (One Star Michelin)
4b P. Yên Thế, Văn Miếu – Quốc Tử Giám, Ba Đình, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
11:00AM - 2:30PM and 5:00PM - 10:00PM

🍖 *CHẢ ỐC* (Vietnamese Ham with Periwinkle Snails)
Served with herbs, vegetables, vermicelli and fish sauce.
💸 *₫295,000 VND / $11 USD*

🐟 *CÁ KHO* (Braised Fish/Clay-Pot Fish)
💸 *₫192,000 VND / $7.30 USD*

🐌 *ỐC CHUỐI ĐẬU* (Snail Stewed With Green Banana And Tofu, Served with Noodles)
💸 *₫330,000 VND / $12.50 USD*

comments.author: @ashleyzviitei
comments.text:
Very interesting how people in northern Vietnam/Hanoi are camera shy and borderline rude/hostile about being filmed. 
I get that not everyone wants to be filmed...privacy, busy, having a lousy day etc. Not everyone wants to be on the internet...and not everyone knows or cares that you are a big, famous YouTuber with a massive following...but you took it in your stride, with good humour. We even got to hear Sonny try to negotiate with the security lady in Vietnamese. She doesnt know that you are her brother-in-law and should treat you nicer 😂😅.
Anyway, despite the challenges, thanks for showing us all the candid angles and perspectives...the different reception you sometimes get in these places. We appreciate it.
#Balance.

comments.author: @SubEveryLanguage
comments.text: In Vietnam, you don't necessarily need to seek out Michelin-starred restaurants. Instead, look for local eateries. At these places, you will enjoy food of equal or even superior quality, but at a significantly lower price. Vietnam has no shortage of talented chefs who can cook dishes on par with those at Michelin-starred establishments. The main difference is that Michelin restaurants are more famous, meticulously organized, have stricter hygiene standards, and feature nicer decor. In short, you are paying for the peripheral dining experience rather than just the food itself. My advice is to find local spots frequented by everyday residents, rather than places that are just famous on the internet
